slides.content_brief: Title the slide 'Typography that holds'. Demonstrate that HTML slides support live code demos, embedded videos, interactive charts (D3, Chart.js), scroll-triggered animations, and audience polling — all native to the browser. Bullet list of interactive capabilities with a callout contrasting PowerPoint's limited preset transitions and broken embedded media
slides.assumes: The audience values engagement and dynamic content in presentations
slides.hands_off: HTML slides can be genuinely interactive, not just animated — a qualitative leap over PowerPoint
